hops.error: HOST_REGISTRATION_FAILED: Extension host rejects non-built-in extensions. ExtensionWorkerHost.activate() explicitly enforces: "if (!extension.enabled || !extension.isBuiltIn || extension.executionState !== 'built-in') return;". Because "ms-python.python" has isBuiltIn=false and executionState='installed', it is completely dropped by the host and never registered in a Worker session.

summary: Live probe against Open VSX registry completed in 12219ms. Hops E1..E5 succeed (VSIX downloaded 6.8MB, unpacked 2382 files, manifest validated). Hop E6 FAILS with HOST_REGISTRATION_FAILED because the extension runtime host strictly rejects non-built-in extensions (!extension.isBuiltIn || executionState !== 'built-in') and worker isolates only execute the 5 hardcoded built-in modules. The marketplace implementation is currently METADATA-ONLY.
